author: reek
body: Runtime probe for the identity capability: the key syscalls (15 load, 16 zero, 18 status) consult the per-process capability word before touching the pinned identity key. The program declares Identity, so the boot grant derived from its own manifest includes the identity bit: it loads a key (status flips to 1), zeros it (status back to 0), then strips its own grant word and asks again. The kernel refuses with -1 without touching the key region.
